blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Comprehensive understanding of introductory principles provides the foundation for advanced concepts.
Conceptual clarity in basic definitions is crucial for solving high-yield objective questions.
Regular revision of foundational topics ensures accuracy and speed during competitive examinations.

blocks.content: Building a strong conceptual foundation in the introductory phase is crucial for tackling complex examination problems.

items: Direct questions on fundamental definitions and core terminology frequently appear in preliminary examinations.
Pay special attention to basic classification schemes and foundational frameworks emphasized in the introductory section.
